source.author: verg
source.text: nunc oblita mihi tot carmina; vox quoque Moerim iam fugit ipsa; lupi Moerim videre priores.
source.text_original: nunc oblita mihi tot carmina; vox quoque Moerim / iam fugit ipsa; lupi Moerim videre priores.
source.text_english: Now so many songs have slipped from my memory; even my voice itself has now fled from me, Moeris; the wolves saw Moeris first.
